name: 40055-longdecode-qwen35moe35b-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one a3 node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, expert parallelism off -- one GPU, one in-process engine, no sharding.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, bounded at 12 requests / 420 s safety, warmup 15% and cooldown 5% by completion.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, no shared prefix: exactly 256 prompt tokens and exactly 256 output tokens per request, EOS ignored, greedy (temperature 0), static seed 40055.
purpose: A single-user drafting assistant producing steady 256-token replies from short prompts on one 35B-parameter model GPU.
launch:
model: amd/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-MXFP4

tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
enable-expert-parallel: false

moe-backend: emulation

# PINNED: this checkpoint declares max_position_embeddings 262144, and letting the engine size a
# KV pool against a 256k window would consume the card. The workload's worst case is 512 tokens.
max-model-len: 4096

# 16, not the default: 30 of the 40 layers are linear-attention mixers whose recurrent state pool
# is sized by max_num_seqs, so a large value reserves tens of GiB for slots that are never filled.
max-num-seqs: 16

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.85
dtype: bfloat16
